description: AED設置箇所一覧(公共施設) [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 山鹿市. 山鹿市内の公共施設におけるＡＥＤ設置箇所一覧です。. Coverage: 山鹿市. The portal files it under the publisher 山鹿市. Its tags are AED設置個所, 位置情報. It offers 4 resource(s) in csv, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-06-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
